images.observation: Three vertical conductors: two thin outer plates with outward mid-height leads and one full-height hatched finite-thickness slab. Printed dimensions d at top, x above l at bottom. Both gaps are open. d/x outside arrows point inward to their boundary extensions; l inside arrows point outward to the two outer-plate extensions. No numeric values, formulas, electric field arrows, or charge symbols. Accepted speck at (205,9) is scan noise only.

Actually inspected: white nonblank raster, both complete outer plates, two outward terminal leads, closed full-height inserted slab and rising diagonal hatching. Two positive vacuum gaps, no contacts to the slab. All six arrowheads and d/x/l endpoint relationships visible. All three labels distinct, unobscured and inside canvas. No formula, derived right-gap label, supply, ground, or induced-charge marking.
